listing.name: NiteLib v1.1.0 [Update I]
listing.summary: QOL library mod to no longer search and write out string id's.
listing.aiSummary: Provides utility classes for modders to retrieve vanilla string IDs and variables without manual searching.

description: Offers "id-finder" classes that allow modders to access vanilla strings and IDs programmatically. It aims to improve consistency and reduce the hassle of manually locating data such as planet types and star system identifiers.
descriptionHtml: Offers "id-finder" classes that allow modders to access vanilla strings and IDs programmatically. It aims to improve consistency and reduce the hassle of manually locating data such as planet types and star system identifiers.

adding.quote: Can be added to your game as far as I know.

removing.quote: However once used by any mod it can no longer be removed without needing to start a new save due to the save including data used from this mod.
